parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.email, a.nombre, a.rol, a.rol_nombre, a.rol_anterior, a.resumen,
       a.secciones_json, a.url_panel, a.asignado_por
  FROM usuarios_avisos_rol a
  JOIN users_config uc ON uc.id = a.user_id AND LOWER(TRIM(uc.email)) = LOWER(TRIM(a.email))
  JOIN roles r ON r.id = uc.role_id AND r.name = a.rol
 WHERE a.id = $1
   AND a.enviado_at IS NULL
   AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
 LIMIT 1
UPDATE usuarios_avisos_rol SET enviado_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
